ContentTypes.description: List of available content types for messages.

DefaultContentType.description: The default content type selected when creating a new message.

CommonApplicationProperties.description: List of common application properties available for quick addition.

additionalProperties.description: Dictionary of scenarios for a specific entity (Queue/Topic). Key is the Scenario Name.

CannedMessages.description: Dictionary of canned messages. Key is the Entity Name (or wildcard pattern using asterisks '*').

LastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the last update to the settings.

Body.description: The message body content. This should be formatted according to the ContentType (e.g., serialized JSON for application/json, XML string for application/xml, or plain text).
